goal: Document a unified error-handling strategy for the codebase to resolve repeated debates across subsystems
Guide developers on when to use return values, exceptions, or fail-fast termination
agreement: Concept approval for establishing a unified error-handling policy (sedited, josibake, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: contradicts existing Expected and Result practice, adding technical debt (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: creates contradictory documentation and belongs in developer notes (maflcko)
Contested objection: aborting on defects risks wallet corruption and node resilience (furszy, mzumsande)
Contested objection: broad exceptions cause unpredictable control flow (l0rinc, maflcko)
